question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59d7dfac778228979e1b5abd90e45ab289e0c86ccc2691157e0c3de2242e83c2.png]
solution: We compare the figures and identify the faces opposite to each other: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da84c23200d940a25b61ee7ea2d31bd816670d6f35ad4f86c59343a39a826273.png] When we compare figure 1st and 2ⁿd we can see that 4 is opposite to 6.
